expires_today.title: Creature and Character Creation Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Bring monstrosities, blood-dripping creatures, and ghastly ghouls to life with a curated bundle of assets designed to get your players’ hearts pumping! Pay what you want for hundreds of specialized asset packs that work seamlessly with your preferred creation platforms, such as VDM Blender and ZBrush, including Faceit: Facial Expressions and Performance Capture and Base Mesh Mega Pack 3D Models - Human, Anime & Cartoon Animals. Plus, your purchase includes 44 ears, 44 teeth, 44 noses, and much, much more. Create amazing monsters before it’s too late, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2026.

expires_today.title: The Unity Game Development Mastery Bundle by Zenva
expires_today.description: Start your game dev journey with Zenva
expires_today.long_description: Learn the knowledge you need to succeed in modern game development with a little help from the pros at Zenva. Pay what you want for instructor-recorded courses, practice exams, mini-project games to further build your skills, and more. Get up to speed quickly with lessons like Intermediate Design Patterns in C# with Unity 6 and Create a 2D Platformer in Unity: Build a Side-Scrolling Game from Scratch before it’s too late! Realize your artistic vision in 3D or 2D and help support Alzheimer's Research UK!

expires_tomorrow.title: Unreal Environment Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Craft beautiful vistas in a fraction of the time it normally takes your team with the all-new Unreal Environment Bundle. Set the scene for epic boss battles, cozy sims, and more with crisp, easy-to-use preset Environmental Packs like Coast & Dunes, Mountain, Forest, Meadow, and more. Add layers of detailed depth to any scenery or scenario with asset sets that mesh seamlessly with each other. Unlock everything you need from the ground up with these elite environmental tools from NatureManufacture, and help support the Starlight Children's Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete Inkle Library
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Dive into worlds unknown and challenges unconquered with this bundle of interactive narrative puzzle games from Inkle! Search through an archive of lost books hidden inside an old computer to solve the secrets of TR-49! Decipher the language of an ancient civilization hidden inside a nebula in Heaven’s Vault! Climb, jump, run, and sing your way through the rainy Scottish highlands in A Highland Song! Take on Jules Verne’s legendary trip around the world in the award-winning globetrotting game 80 Days! There are even more Inkle classics to be found in this exciting bundle, so get it now at the price of your choice and help support Breakthrough T1D with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before January 1st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Yuri in Luck: Waifus for Laifus
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Find love, companionship, and maybe a little romance with the Yuri in Luck: Waifus for Laifus Bundle—a colorful collection of LGBTQ+-themed yuri titles! Play “Yuri Cupid” in Kindred Spirits on the Roof, a slice-of-life tale of love, loss, lust, and friendship. Lead a romantic cat-and-mouse game with a supernatural spin across a gorgeous watercolor-style backdrop in OshiRabu: Waifus Over Husbandos. Or lose yourself in SeaBed, a deep psychological mystery visual novel told through the perspectives of three unique characters. Plus, your purchase helps support our friends at Dames 4 Games.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 1st, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Roll Big or Go Home 2
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Become the main character of your favorite novel, film series, or game with this giant bundle of tabletop roleplaying books! This TTRPG library features core rulebooks and adventures set in tons of different franchises, from Doctor Who and Warhammer to Cthulhu, Transformers, and even My Little Pony! Basically, if you’re a fan of something, it’s probably in here. You’ll also find core books from classic roleplaying franchises like Return to Dark Tower and original storylines like Household and Visigoths vs. Mall Goths! Assemble your friends, grab a set of dice, and pick from over 50 TTRPG books to plan your next one-night adventure or neverending campaign. Grab this bundle now for the price of your choosing, and support Tabletop Gaymers with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before June 25, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The 2026 Learn Unity Game Development Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Unlock your creative side with Unity
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Your new career in game development is only a click away with The 2026 Learn Unity Game Development Bundle! Get the expert instruction you need from pros in the field, and help support Trees, Water & People with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before June 25th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: We Will Always Be Here: Pride Month 2026
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Celebrate Pride Month 2026 with a bundle of queer-centric and inclusive games of all genres! There’s even more adventure, romance, and fun to be found in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing and support the Trevor Project with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Melodic Mayhem Vol. 2: A Comprehensive Audio and Music Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: So much melodic mayhem we had to drop a Vol. 2!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Create the perfect audioscape for your next game or creative project with the Melodic Mayhem Vol. 2: A Comprehensive Audio and Music Bundle. Explore a variety of genres, from Heavy Metal guitars to soothing fantasy strings and everything in between. Get the assets you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support a charity of your choice with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before June 18th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Robyn Carr's Virgin River
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Enter a quiet mountain town where things are a lot more complicated than they seem on the surface with this 21-ebook bundle of Robyn Carr’s bestselling Virgin River—the series that inspired the hit Netflix show! Meet a recently widowed nurse as she attempts to fit in with the residents of the remote California town while also caring for an abandoned infant in the very first novel Virgin River. Follow along as a former Marine saves a woman on the run with her young child in Shelter Mountain. Root for the town’s first resident cop as he attempts to settle down with the gal who’s stolen his heart in Whispering Rock. Imagine yourself cozied up by the fire inside the mountain cabin of your dreams with a hot chocolate in one hand and this ebook bundle in the other. Pay what you want for the entire series, and support Room to Read with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through Kobo.com. To access the content, create or log in to your Kobo.com account.
